confidence_notes: The live site kept search results on CorpSearch.aspx after ASP.NET postback, despite the requester mentioning CorpSearchResults.aspx; the script follows the inspected live behavior.

The script uses Playwright because search submission and pagination require ASP.NET postbacks and JavaScript; requests is used for HTTP preflight/status diagnostics rather than a nonexistent entity-data API.
Only the first results page was inspected directly; page-2 handling is implemented from the observed __doPostBack pagination pattern but was not verified live.
Current Status was not visible in the inspected detail summary. The script checks #MainContent_tblStatus and records a missing-field flag when it is absent, without inventing a value.
Entity Type and detail-page fields are extracted from label/value rows where available, with conservative table-text fallbacks because the exact internal row markup was not provided.
Reviewer, registered-agent, resident, and officer tables are not extracted. No review accordion is opened; mask_reviews is retained as a contract-compatible option.
The requested diagnostic screenshot is logged on zero records, but a screenshot cannot be guaranteed if browser startup or navigation fails before a usable Playwright page exists.
Product IDs use the detail URL sysvalue consistently, falling back to a URL-derived identifier only when sysvalue is unavailable.
The fallback input keyword 'mobius' is used only when input.xlsx is absent; this assumption is based on the inspection sample and is noted for operational transparency.
Duplicate-looking entities are preserved and are not deduplicated.
